title: Term Life Insurance Reinstatement Interest Rate by Lapse Gap
content:
**Reinstatement guideline — Term Life Insurance.** The annual rate of reinstatement interest is set by the lapse gap: the number of calendar days from the lapse date on record to the date the approved reinstatement application was signed.

| Lapse gap | Reinstatement interest rate |
|---|---|
| 15 days or less | 2 percent a year (0.02) |
| 16 through 90 days | 4 percent a year (0.04) |
| more than 90 days | the product's reinstatement interest rate |

**Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical).** Lapse date 2 March 2026: an application signed 17 March 2026 (15 days) takes 2 percent; one signed 18 March 2026 (16 days) takes 4 percent; one signed 31 May 2026 (90 days) takes 4 percent; one signed 1 June 2026 (91 days) takes the product's rate.

The gap runs to the signed date of the approved reinstatement application, not to the date the reinstatement amount is paid.
